data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes an integration of two SRCs' misframings (timing-snapshot plus floor-as-label), but the resulting mechanism is internally incoherent: if timing-chip snapshots establish precedence (overtaken retains second by chip), then the overtaker's position is determined by chip timing, not by a 'floor' on the overtaken runner's label. The floor mechanism (crediting the overtaker with third while the overtaken keeps second) requires two runners occupying rank 2 simultaneously in the recording, which is not a composite of independent misframings but a contradiction — standard timing-chip precedence would place the overtaker behind the overtaken (third) regardless of any floor, so the floor adds no explanatory power and the two mechanisms collapse into one rather than genuinely integrating.
